Which Gujarati film won the 70th National Film Award for Best Feature Film promoting national, social and environmental values?
o: More than one of the above
x: At the 70th National Film Awards, 2022 (conferred on October 8, 2024) the Gujarati film ‘Kutch Express’ won the award for Best Feature Film Promoting National, Social and Environmental Values. At the 71st National Film Awards, the Golden Lotus (Swarna Kamal) award for Best Feature Film was awarded to ‘12th Fail’.

s: The Right of Livelihood Award was established in the year
x: The Right Livelihood Award, often called the ' Alternative Nobel Prize ', was established in 1980 by Jakob von Uexkull to honour work addressing today's most urgent challenges. It recognises individuals and organisations for practical solutions in areas like environment, human rights, and sustainable development. The award is presented annually in the Swedish Parliament.

s: Awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2024, Han Kang's novel 'The Vegetarian' won which other prestigious award?
o: More than one of the above
x: South Korean writer Han Kang was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature, 2024. For her novel ‘The Vegetarian’, Han Kang, along with translator Deborah Smith, won the 2016 Man Booker International Prize (the award now called the International Booker Prize). This novel won neither the Pulitzer Prize nor a PEN America Literary Award.

s: The first Indian to win an Oscar Award was:
x: Bhanu Athaiya Bhanu Athaiya became the first Indian to win an Academy Award (Oscar). She won it for Best Costume Design for the film ' Gandhi ' (1982). This made her a pioneering figure for Indians in international cinema.

s: Mahmoud Abu Zeid has won the 2018 UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize. He hails from which country?
x: Egyptian photojournalist Mahmoud Abu Zeid, known as Shawkan, has been selected by an independent international jury of media professionals as the laureate of the 2018 UNESCO/Guillermo Cano Press Freedom Prize. The prize was awarded on 2nd May on the occasion of World Press Freedom Day. UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize for 2024 was given to Palestinian Journalists covering Gaza.
